name: Mathematics I Calculus
description: Sequences of real numbers: real number system and its completeness property, Archimedean property, definitions of sequence and convergence, Cauchy sequence, definition of limit superior and inferior. Infinite series: series of real numbers, absolute and conditional convergence, alternating series, test for convergence: comparison, Cauchy condensation, ratio, root, Leibniz’s tests. Differential calculus: limits, continuity, differentiability, mean value theorems, Taylor’s theorem, Taylor’s series, power series, maxima and minima. Integral calculus: definition of Riemann integral, properties, fundamental theorems, improper integrals of first and second kind, beta and gamma functions. Multivariable differential calculus: functions of several variables, limits, continuity, partial derivatives, directional derivatives, differentiability, chain rule, gradient, Taylor’s theorem, maxima and minima in two variables, method of Lagrange multipliers. Multivariable integral calculus: double and triple integrals, Jacobian and change of variables, polar, spherical, and cylindrical coordinate systems, surface integrals, applications to area, volume and surface.
